import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a comprehensive visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels with size as weight
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                     s=df['weight_grams']/3, alpha=0.6, 
                     c=df['model_year'], cmap='viridis')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(Size = Weight)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
for i, brand in enumerate(df['brand']):
    ax1.annotate(brand, (df['megapixels'].iloc[i], df['price_usd'].iloc[i]), 
                fontsize=8, alpha=0.7)
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Year')

# 2. Brand comparison - Price
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
sns.barplot(data=df, x='brand', y='price_usd', palette='Set2', ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Price by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Sensor Type Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette('pastel'))
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Weight vs ISO
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter2 = ax4.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['max_iso'], 
                      c=df['price_usd'], cmap='coolwarm', s=150, alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Weight vs Max ISO\n(Color = Price)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter2, ax=ax4, label='Price (USD)')

# 5. Model Year Timeline
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.scatter(df['model_year'], df['megapixels'], s=df['price_usd']/10, 
           alpha=0.6, c=range(len(df)), cmap='tab10')
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Megapixels Over Years\n(Size = Price)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
for i, brand in enumerate(df['brand']):
    ax5.annotate(brand, (df['model_year'].iloc[i], df['megapixels'].iloc[i]), 
                fontsize=8, alpha=0.7)

# 6. Body Type Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
sns.barplot(x=body_counts.index, y=body_counts.values, palette='muted', ax=ax6)
ax6.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 7. 4K Video Support
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
video_4k = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
ax7.bar(['No 4K', '4K'], [video_4k.get(0, 0), video_4k.get(1, 0)], 
        color=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff'])
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('4K Video Support', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 8. Lens Mount Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
mount_counts = df['lens_mount'].value_counts()
ax8.barh(mount_counts.index, mount_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette('Set3'))
ax8.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Lens Mount', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Lens Mount Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Summary Statistics Table
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.axis('off')
summary_stats = pd.DataFrame({
    'Metric': ['Avg Price', 'Avg MP', 'Avg Weight', 'Avg ISO'],
    'Value': [f"${df['price_usd'].mean():.0f}", 
              f"{df['megapixels'].mean():.1f}",
              f"{df['weight_grams'].mean():.0f}g",
              f"{df['max_iso'].mean():.0f}"]
})
table = ax9.table(cellText=summary_stats.values, colLabels=summary_stats.columns,
                  cellLoc='center', loc='center', bbox=[0, 0, 1, 1])
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(9)
table.scale(1, 2)
ax9.set_title('Summary Statistics', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=20)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
